_about: Copy this file to local_paths.json in the folder you run the notebooks from, and fill in your own locations. local_paths.json is not part of the repository.
bow_shock: folder that holds bs_crossings_V02.xlsx, MagCarto/, Bow_Shock_Stats/, Figures/ and this repository
omni_cache: path to omni2_cache.pkl, written by build_omni2_cache.ipynb
wind_data: folder with the Wind MFI and SWE CDF files (MagCarto_Master.ipynb only)
overleaf: optional: folder of the paper's LaTeX project, if figures are to be written straight into it
